source.quote: Based on cost mitigations and our levers, we are maintaining the outlook for the rest of the year within the $1.1 billion to $1.2 billion range for Packaged Meats operating profit.

Putting that together, our updated full year 2026 adjusted operating profit outlook is as follows: total company adjusted operating profit is now expected to be in the range of $1.225 billion to $1.375 billion.

We now expect to spend between $350 million-$375 million in capital expenditures in 2026, excluding Sioux Falls, with more than half of our planned capital investments focused on projects designed to support both top and bottom-line growth.

We have narrowed our full-year packaged meats operating profit outlook to a range of $1.09 billion-$1.14 billion, with a modest increase at the midpoint, primarily reflecting two months of Nathan's Famous results.
